value.rationale: A physically motivated experimental control question (whether an interior reset rate minimizes non-Gaussian stationary shape while variance always falls) gains an exact yes/no bath-memory phase boundary, unique optimal tuning and two quantitative scaling laws. At a fixed reset frequency the strictly monotone kurtosis gives an identifiable bath-memory proxy. Distinguishing physical variance control from fourth-cumulant shape control is material, not a purely cosmetic formula evaluation.
